title: Tanha hai dushmano me
body:
BECHAIN NAINAWA MEIN HAIN BETI RASOOL SAWW. KI.
SAR PEET-TI HAIN LAB PA HAI FARYAAD BAS YAHI.
GHAR LUT RAHA HAIN MERA MUSIBAT KI HAIN GHADI.
AB TO MADAD KE WAASTE AAJATI YA ALI ASWS.
TANHA HAIN DUSHMANO'N MEIN NAWASA RASOOL SAWW. KA.
1. QASIM ASWS. KA LASHA GHODO'N SE PAAMAL HOGAYA.
TEER E SITAM SE CHID GAYA BESHEER KA GALA.
TOOTI KAMAR HUSSAIN ASWS. KI --ABBAS ASWS. MAR GAYA*2.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. ZAINAB ASWS. NE APNE BACHON KO QURBAAN KARDIYA.
BARCHI JIGAR MEIN DHAS GAYI AKBAR ASWS. BHI CHAL BASA.
KHAATA HAI THOKAREIN'N MERI-- AAGOSH KA PALA..*2.
<<DIVIDER>>
3. TALWAAR E NAUZE BARCHIYAA'N PATTHAR HAI HAR TARAF.
TANHA GHAREEB BEKAS O MAZLOOM HAI HADAF.
BINTE RASOOL SAWW. KARTI HAIN-- FARIYAAD YAA QUDA JJH..*2.
<<DIVIDER>>
4. DASHTE BALA MEIN GOONJTE HAIN FATIMA S.A. KE BAIN.
LAASHE UTHAA KE THAK GAYA HAIN MERA NOOR E AIN.
AB ZERE TEGH HAI USI-- MAZLOOM KA GALAA..*2.
<<DIVIDER>>
5. KUCH SOOJHTA NAHI MUJHE AAWAZ KISKO DU'N.
FARIYAAD MERI SUNTA NAHI KOI KYA KARU'N.
ALLAH JJH. ZIBHA HOTA HAIN-- ZEHRA S.A. KA LAADLA..*2.
<<DIVIDER>>
6. NAAZO'N SE MAINE PAALA ISE CHAKKI PEESKAR.
KAISA YEH ZULM KARTE HAI US PAR YEH EHLE SHAR L.A.
PAAMAL UNKA LAASHA-- ZAMEE'N PAR PADAA HUAA..*2.
<<DIVIDER>>
7. ZEHRA S.A. KA NAUHA GOONJTA HAIN DASHT MEIN RASHEED.
AANSOO BAHAO HO GAYA IBNE ALI ASWS. SHAHEED.
MATAM KARO LABO'N PA-- RAHE WAA MUSEEBATA..*2.
Kalaam: JANAB RASHEED SHAHEEDI SAHAB.
